user.title: EasyPark
user.description: Connect to the companion phone Agent (LAN API) on which the EasyPark app is installed and signed in.

data_description.host: Fixed IP address of the companion phone (e.g. a DHCP reservation).
data_description.token: Shown in the VAG Companion Agent app (Copy token).
data_description.zone: For example P4-1925. It is searched in EasyPark.
data_description.plates: Comma-separated; every plate must exist as a vehicle in EasyPark.
data_description.max_price: A purchase whose total on the Confirm parking screen is higher is not started.
data_description.return_package: Android package brought to the front after each purchase. Leave empty to stay in EasyPark.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Agent with this address and token.
error.easypark_missing: The EasyPark app is not installed on the phone.
error.no_plates: Enter at least one license plate.

abort.already_configured: This phone and zone are already configured.
